zh.title: 漢光演習國軍搭客輪馳援綠島蘭嶼驗證防衛能量
zh.summary: 國軍「漢光42號演習」於2026年8月6日進入第2天，逾百名官兵在台東富岡漁港搭乘客輪，運送建制武器與物資馳援綠島及蘭嶼。第二作戰區表示，本次演練採實兵實物驗證離島應援能量，官兵登島後即構築防禦工事並操作無人機進行戰術偵查。
body: 國軍「漢光42號演習」於2026年8月6日進入第2天。台東富岡漁港上午集結逾百名官兵，在登上客輪並完成建制武器與軍需物資裝載後，搭船前往綠島與蘭嶼。
第二作戰區表示，本次「登島防衛作戰演練」採實兵、實地與實物方式，驗證離島應援能量。部隊登島後進入戰術位置，構築防禦工事並操作無人機實施戰術偵查。
軍方人士說明，演練想定包含阻斷敵軍奪取離島作為直升機與無人機起降的前進基地，或藉此突破第一島鏈，國軍遂迅速馳援離島以驗證守備能量。

en.title: Han Kuang Exercise: Troops Board Ferries to Reinforce Green Island and Orchid Island
en.summary: On August 6, 2026, during the second day of the Han Kuang 42 exercise, over 100 military personnel gathered at Fugang Fishery Harbor in Taitung to board passenger ferries with weapons and supplies, embarking for Green Island and Orchid Island. Taiwan's Second Operational Zone stated that the cross-sea exercise verified offshore island reinforcement capabilities using live personnel and equipment, with troops deploying to tactical positions to construct defense fortifications and perform tactical drone reconnaissance.
body: On August 6, 2026, during the second day of the Han Kuang 42 exercise, over 100 armed Taiwanese military personnel gathered at Fugang Fishery Harbor in Taitung. The troops loaded organic weapons and military supplies onto passenger ferries before departing for Green Island and Orchid Island.

Taiwan's Second Operational Zone stated that the cross-sea island defense exercise utilized live troops, locations, and equipment to verify offshore island reinforcement capabilities. Upon arrival at tactical positions, troops constructed defense fortifications and operated drones for tactical reconnaissance drills.

A military source said the drill scenario involved preventing opposing forces from seizing the offshore islands as forward bases for helicopter and drone operations or breaking through the first island chain.
